original_test_intent: Use the BMC HTTPS Maintenance/HPM firmware-update page to alternate the approved PSU N and N-1 firmware for five cycles, verifying activation, BMC re-login, power-cycle recovery and PSU health after each transition.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Login to BMC WebUI, open Maintenance/HPM firmware update, update PSU firmware, wait, reboot, re-login, and repeat N/N-1 five times.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: WebUI login/page access, successful PSU firmware update, and SUT power-cycle recovery.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; image, vendor/BMC flash method, maintenance window and sensor/FW readback required.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED because identities, images, sequence, power topology and recovery were missing.
historical_reviews.v3: RECLASSIFIED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION while preserving five cycles and firmware safety gates.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Engineer operates and visually verifies the specified WebUI path unless an approved project tool explicitly covers that same HPM workflow; agent may collect read-only pre/post evidence.
required_user_inputs: Signed N and N-1 images, hashes, compatibility and downgrade authorization
Vendor HPM/WebUI SOP and exact five-cycle order
Redundancy, maintenance, recovery and power-cycle plan

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: Five N/N-1 cycles through BMC WebUI; 60 minutes attended and 240 minutes machine planning values.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Exact images/targets/order, approved cycle count and method, maintenance and recovery.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: If a project approves fewer than five cycles, that run may complete its approved scope but the unexecuted master cycles remain an explicit coverage gap.

original_method: BMC HTTPS Maintenance/HPM firmware-update page. Preserve this WebUI path and its visual page/login evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an existing project/vendor PSU update utility or PA Manager Cycle only if its qualified version targets the same PSU HPM function and reproduces every N/N-1 transition, activation and recovery check.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project/vendor private SOP required; no public generic endpoint is asserted.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original: May automate task monitoring and repeated evidence collection but cannot replace required WebUI functional evidence unless project scope is explicitly changed.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Tool coverage must include all five transitions, firmware readback, BMC recovery and SUT power cycle.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware mutation and PSU output loss remain possible; no automatic retry.

missing_inputs: Qualified images and exact target map
safety_boundaries: No flash until image-to-PSU compatibility, redundancy and OOB recovery are proven.
Stop on PSU output loss, flash error, management loss or incomplete recovery.
expected_evidence: Per-cycle target/image/hash and flash transcript or WebUI screenshots
Activated firmware and PSU sensor/output readback
BMC reconnect, SEL/host delta and power-cycle recovery
First failure preserved separately from later loops
no_automatic_retry: A failed transition ends the approved sequence unless the engineer approves a distinct recovery or retry plan. A later successful flash never overwrites the original failure.
engineer_owned_verdict: Tool/WebUI success is raw evidence; only the engineer assigns formal PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.
review_improvement: V3.1 keeps V3's classification but adds the five-cycle Master-versus-Project coverage rule, preserves WebUI as the function under test, prefers an existing qualified cycle tool without equating tool success to coverage, and makes retry prohibition explicit.
